full_judgment: 3. Krishnapada Biswas and others, the predecessors of the respondents herein as the plaintiffs filed Title Suit No.1208 of 1983 against Saburannessa Bibi and others, the predecessors of the appellants, seeking declaration of title in the suit land, which consisted of 30 decimals of land situated in plot No.307 and also 03 decimals of land situated in other plot, both under khatian No.133 of Mouza and P.S. Jhenaidah and also for recovery of khas possession thereof on the averments that above plot No.307 measuring 63 decimals of land belonged to Fazar Ali and others. Subsequently, Sattendra Nath became the owner of the same, and then on 15th Chaitra B.S, 1354, Sattendra Nath leased 30 decimals of land situated on the northern side of plot No.307 to Haripada, his servant, who then constructing a house started living therein. But the survey record was wrongly prepared in the name of Sattendra Nath. On 15th Kartick,1375 B.S, Jagadish disclosed to Haripada that the record of right in respect of the suit land stands in the name of Sattendra and he had purchased the suit land from Sattendra Nath along with other lands. After coming to know about the same, Haripada filed Miscellaneous Case No.566 of 1969 under section 143(a) of State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950 for correction of the record of right and then the above miscellaneous case was stayed with a direction to the other side to file a regular title suit by 20.05.1970 and such suit not being filed, decision was given in favour of Haripada on 15.06.1970. During the liberation war, Haripada was shot dead in his own house. From suit plot No.307, which contained 60 decimals of land(but wrongly written 63 decimals in khatian), Jagadish purchased only 33 decimals of land from Sattendra Nath but he in his kabala from Sattendra Nath, fraudulently included the entire land of the plot, which was owned by Haripada and Amanat Mollah. Haripada died leaving his wife Bimala Bala, who sold 03 decimals of land to Manju Rani, respondent No.6 of Civil Revision No.286 of 2001. Then Bimala Bala on 24.7.73 sold 10 decimals and on 01.09.1975 sold 17 decimals of land to plaintiff No.1 and Basanti Bala. They dug a pond in 15 decimals of purchased land. Basanti Bala on 14.7.1976 sold 02 decimals of land to Monto Kumar. The defendant earlier filed Title Suit No.869 of 1981, which ended on filing a solenama which was forcefully obtained by the defendants from the plaintiff. Thereafter, defendants forcibly took possession of the suit land on 15.11.1981. Then on 10.10.1982 defendant constructed a straw-hut on the bank of the pond which is situated within the suit land.
